name: Crest of Lordaeron

angles.text: As former citizens of Lordaeron, the Forsaken treasure surviving relics of their fallen kingdom as rare remnants of their past lives and heritage.
Assisting Forsaken archivists in Undercity helps preserve the material legacy of Lordaeron amidst the ruins left by the Scourge.

faq.answer: The Crest of Lordaeron is a weathered emblem bearing the mark of the fallen human kingdom. Because very few physical relics survived the Scourge's destruction, it is an invaluable piece of history to those attempting to preserve Lordaeron's legacy.
faq.q: What is the Crest of Lordaeron?

faq.answer: The crest is brought to Oran Snakewrithe, who resides within the Undercity. Oran carefully inspects and safeguards recovered artifacts tied to the old kingdom.
faq.q: Who wants the crest in Undercity?

faq.answer: Upon receiving the crest, Oran Snakewrithe bites into it to verify its authenticity and material composition before declaring it a genuine, mostly intact relic of Lordaeron.
faq.q: Why does Oran Snakewrithe bite the crest?

aliases: why do forsaken care about lordaeron
faq.answer: The Forsaken are the undead remnants of Lordaeron's former population. Despite their undeath and new allegiance, relics of their destroyed homeland represent tangible links to their history and identity.
faq.q: Why do the Forsaken value relics of Lordaeron?

faq.answer: Oran Snakewrithe takes custody of the crest to ensure it is kept safe, treating it as a precious historical treasure that aids in restoring and remembering their kingdom's heritage.
faq.q: What will happen to the crest after it is turned in?

faq.answer: Physical emblems and relics from before the Third War are exceptionally scarce. Most symbols of Lordaeron were smashed, looted, or corrupted when Arthas and the Scourge overran the realm.
faq.q: How rare are surviving relics from Lordaeron?

sections.body: The kingdom of Lordaeron was shattered during the Third War, leaving little behind except ash, ruins, and Scourge desolation. Because so much of the realm's material culture was annihilated, surviving insignias and emblems like the Crest of Lordaeron are exceptionally rare. To the Forsaken dwelling beneath the ruins of the Capital City, these surviving objects are precious physical links to the civilization they once belonged to.
sections.title: A Surviving Symbol of the Fallen Kingdom

sections.body: When recovered from the wider world, the weathered crest is delivered to Oran Snakewrithe in the Undercity. Oran verifies its authenticity—even testing the metal by biting it—before confirming it as an authentic, mostly intact heirloom of their home. For Oran and the Forsaken archivists, each salvaged piece helps piece together a history that the Scourge sought to utterly erase.
sections.title: Preserving Forsaken Heritage

summary: The Crest of Lordaeron is a weathered historical artifact bearing the emblem of the fallen kingdom. With few such treasures surviving the Scourge's destruction, it is delivered to Oran Snakewrithe in Undercity to help preserve the Forsaken's past heritage.
attribution: In-game quest text: Crest of Lordaeron
